title: 3.0 - Issue when selecting a virtual field on the fly when using multiple finders, then sorting by that field

body:
Hey guys. In my app I have a Table that needs to be 1. Translatable and 2. Searchable. I've set up a SearchableBehavior (viewable @ https://gist.github.com/patrickconroy/c605ea97afeca5c46afd).

My Table looks like:

```
public function initialize(array $config) {
    $this->addBehavior('Searchable', ['fields' => ['Posts.keywords' => 2, 'Posts_title_translation.content' => 4]]);
    $this->addBehavior('Translate', ['fields' => ['title', 'content']]);
}
```

My Controller:

```
$posts = $this->Posts->find('translations')->find('search', ['q' => $q])->limit(20)->all();
```

This works fine if all I do is search and add the score to the row (line 52 of the gist). But when I try to order on that new field (line 57) I get the error:
`
SQLSTATE[42S22]: Column not found: 1054 Unknown column \u0027score\u0027 in \u0027order clause\u0027
`
This is because `findTranslations` adds a query that keeps the `ORDER BY` from the first query, when the field added in the first query is just a virtual one. The two query this whole thing creates are:
1. This one is fine:

```
SELECT `Posts`.id,
(MATCH(Posts.keywords) AGAINST('foobar') * 2) + (MATCH(Posts_title_translation.content) AGAINST('foobar') * 4) AS `score`,
`Posts_title_translation`.`id` AS `Posts_title_translation__id`, `Posts_title_translation`.`content` AS `Posts_title_translation__content`, `Posts_content_translation`.`id` AS `Posts_content_translation__id`, `Posts_content_translation`.`content` AS `Posts_content_translation__content`
FROM `posts` `Posts`
LEFT JOIN `i18n` `Posts_title_translation` ON (`Posts_title_translation`.`model` = 'Posts' AND `Posts_title_translation`.`field` = 'title' AND `Posts_title_translation`.`locale` = 'en_us' AND `Posts`.`id` = (`Posts_title_translation`.`foreign_key`))
LEFT JOIN `i18n` `Posts_content_translation` ON (`Posts_content_translation`.`model` = 'Posts' AND `Posts_content_translation`.`field` = 'content' AND `Posts_content_translation`.`locale` = 'en_us' AND `Posts`.`id` = (`Posts_content_translation`.`foreign_key`))
WHERE (MATCH(Posts.keywords) AGAINST('foobar' in boolean mode) OR MATCH(Posts_title_translation.content) AGAINST('foobar' in boolean mode))
ORDER BY `score` DESC LIMIT 20
```
1. Errors because `score` is undefined:

```
SELECT `i18n`.`id` AS `i18n__id`, `i18n`.`locale` AS `i18n__locale`, `i18n`.`model` AS `i18n__model`, `i18n`.`foreign_key` AS `i18n__foreign_key`, `i18n`.`field` AS `i18n__field`, `i18n`.`content` AS `i18n__content`, `i18n`.`scope` AS `i18n__scope`
FROM `i18n` `i18n` INNER JOIN (SELECT (`Posts`.`id`) FROM `posts` `Posts`
LEFT JOIN `i18n` `Posts_title_translation` ON (`Posts_title_translation`.`model` = 'Posts' AND `Posts_title_translation`.`field` = 'title' AND `Posts_title_translation`.`locale` = 'en_us' AND `Posts`.`id` = (`Posts_title_translation`.`foreign_key`))
LEFT JOIN `i18n` `Posts_content_translation` ON (`Posts_content_translation`.`model` = 'Posts' AND `Posts_content_translation`.`field` = 'content' AND `Posts_content_translation`.`locale` = 'en_us' AND `Posts`.`id` = (`Posts_content_translation`.`foreign_key`))
WHERE (MATCH(Posts.keywords) AGAINST('foobar' in boolean mode) OR MATCH(Posts_title_translation.content) AGAINST('foobar' in boolean mode)) ORDER BY `score` DESC LIMIT 20) `Posts` ON `i18n`.`foreign_key` = (`Posts`.`id`)
WHERE `i18n`.`model` = 'Posts'
```

(I have a `i18n.scope` field, not to be confused the the `score` virtual field I'm talking about.)

Should I be adding my score field the way I'm doing it or another way? I feel like I should be able to do something like `Table::addVirtual` or `Table::entity::addVirtual` on the fly instead of putting it into the `query->select`. Or is there a way to reset my query or tell the second one to not use the ORDER BY from the first one?

Thanks.
